def factor_directional_momentum_volume(df):
    """Multi-day momentum amplified by directional persistence and volume surge, smoothed with EMA."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    # Momentum: 20-day return
    ret_20 = df_copy["close"].pct_change(20)
    # Directional persistence: fraction of up days over 20 days
    up_days = (df_copy["close"].diff() > 0).rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean()
    # Volume surge: continuous volume ratio from classify_volume_regime
    _, _, vol_ratio = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(df_copy["volume"], window=20)
    # Core signal
    raw_signal = ret_20 * up_days * vol_ratio
    # EMA smooth
    smooth_signal = raw_signal.ewm(span=7, min_periods=20).mean()
    df_copy["factor_directional_momentum_volume"] = smooth_signal
    return df_copy["factor_directional_momentum_volume"]
description: Multi-day momentum (20-day return) is amplified by directional persistence (fraction of up days over 20 days) and volume surge (volume ratio from classify_volume_regime). EMA smoothing (span=7) reduces noise while preserving the persistence signal. This captures trends where price direction is confirmed by a high proportion of up days and strong volume, a hallmark of sustained momentum.
